unresolvedReferences.description: The packet lists no reigns, so every explicit era stays a research hold and no Western year is used. 從孫 is stated but is not encoded as parent-of/child-of/spouse-of.
安 and 史 are expanded by the translation to An Lushan and Shi Siming; they are retrospective allusions, not dated by the Taihe speech.
Bare 七年 and 八年 do not restate an era, and the packet maps no Tang reign, so no Western year is used. 會昌初 is a research hold.
太和之初 and 開成之末 belong to the stele's omen language, not to Zhang Zhongwu's or Li Deyu's activity dates. 蚩尤 is figurative.
三年冬, 十一年, and later era names are research holds; the packet lists no Tang reigns. 允申 in s0134 is kept as a textual variant of 允伸, not discarded.
The Yizhou campaign is dated only by 中和末 in s0171; later units do not restate it. 光啟元年春 dates Quanzhong's installation, not Keju's death.
二年春 does not restate 景福. 二月 after 乾寧元年冬 is not assigned a year. 父事之 and 視如子 are deference, not kinship. 王建國 is not a name.
Tian Guang, Jing Ke, An Lushan, and Shi Siming are allusions in the historian's comment and are not dated from this chapter.
